### Representative workflow

The representative primary-care journey that makes the product useful in the release scope.

Closed in the Stage 1A gate family for the representative boundary.
#### 근거

### Provider admission
#### 의미
The external provider boundary where live behavior against the real source is admitted.
This area participates in the Stage 1A release scope but does not own release approval itself.
#### 현재 수준
Live admission against the external provider is NOT PROVEN at this boundary.
Release approval itself is owned at the project horizon.
